subject: app works locally but crashes on server

messages.author: 4645cc5ff080ea4f
messages.subject: app works locally but crashes on server
parts:
Hi,

I was developing shiny app locally and after deploying it on server it came up with an error. I got the following error:

The application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console.

That was interesting error I have never had it before, therefore I have checked what's wrong on JS console and I found: 

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:33494 Shiny URLs starting with /progress will mapped to /usr/lib64/R/library/shinyIncubator/progress Shiny URLs starting with /progress will mapped to /usr/lib64/R/library/shinyIncubator/progress Error in if (file.info(paste(directory, country, "_useless.csv", : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

In the application I have a separate file, which is used for user to store some data. User can add or delete, therefore in the beginning, application checks if file is not empty (this is where it fails) and in this case gives a value NULL, otherwise reads the file and stores data from file. 

The following is beginning of code from server.R where crashes:

directory <- ".../data/"
country <- "usa"

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reads .csv, which stores data
  if (file.info(paste(directory,country,"_useless.csv",sep=""))$size == 0) {
    blackBox2 <- NULL
  } 
  else {
    uselessRead <- read.table(paste(directory,country,"_useless.csv",sep=""),header=FALSE)
    blackBox2 <<- as.vector(uselessRead[,1])
  }
....

However, it is strange, that nothing after "_useless.csv", is read, therefore I couldn't find out why it doesn't work.

If anyone has any ideas, please share it.

Thank you!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] app works locally but crashes on server
parts:
I think the issue is that you are referencing the directory "../data". Only sub directories of your application directory are uploaded to ShinyApps.

If your application code is in "/path/to/my_app", then you should move the data directory to "/path/to/my_app/data" and re run deployApp()

Hope that helps.
-Andy
